name: TRIVE
recent: TRIVE 于 2026 年 10 月 14 日出现审计委员会与风险委员会的人事变动，并于 9 月 30 日公布截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日止季度的合并业绩。近期没有其他重要公告或新闻。
notable: 审计委员会成员出现变动，DATO' HAJI SOHAIMI BIN SHAHADAN 离任。
风险委员会成员出现变动，MR TEOH KIM HOOI 离任。

ann.title: Change in Audit Committee - DATO' HAJI SOHAIMI BIN SHAHADAN
Change in Risk Committee - MR TEOH KIM HOOI
Quarterly rpt on consolidated results for the financial period ended 31/07/2026

recent_en: TRIVE saw changes in its Audit Committee and Risk Committee on 14 October 2026, and released its consolidated quarterly results for the period ended 31 July 2026 on 30 September. There were no other major announcements or news recently.
notable_en: Change in Audit Committee membership with the departure of DATO' HAJI SOHAIMI BIN SHAHADAN.
Change in Risk Committee membership with the departure of MR TEOH KIM HOOI.
